name: Panda Palace 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: In this heartwarming game, you play as a friendly panda who rescues, feeds, and cares for adorable animals like cats, dogs, bunnies, ponies, and even tigers!  Wash them, groom them, give them food and love — and when they’re ready, find them a new loving panda family!
